name: 재키
motion_summary: Eternal Return Jackie Chainsaw Murderer: white spiky hair, red-black look, lively sharp reddish eyes per identity. Pull out a large chainsaw, start its motor, raise and lean into short slashes, then the R recast Massacre is one wide two-handed sweeping chainsaw attack. White/orange metal teeth sparks and dark red slash trails; no gore. Required sequence: ready, grip saw, motor start, lift saw, windup, small cut, reverse windup, huge horizontal Massacre sweep, follow-through, lower saw, settle, ready.
visual_review: 흰 머리·붉은 눈·장비가 유지됩니다. 전기톱 시동, 들어올리기, 학살 휘두르기와 회수 동작을 확인했습니다. 12셀입니다.
